g.text: Papers, contributor populations and the most prolific decile
2010–2025 · 300,011 retained papers · two identity definitions on identical papers
Full-study pool: 178,730 OpenAlex IDs or 231,929 distinct names
Source: frozen OpenAlex metadata, 16 Sep 2026; selected arXiv-linked Mathematics works.
Top 10% uses exact population weight with proportional boundary ties. Names/IDs are observed keys, not validated people.
Whole-study P/A: 1.679 per ID; 1.294 per name (16-year totals, not annual rates).
